## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed (if any).

- Reference: `Fixes #<issue-number>` or `Refers to #<issue-number>`

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would change existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / code-quality improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I used the existing code and design-token conventions
- [ ] I ran `npm run lint` in `frontend/` and it passes
- [ ] I ran `npm run build` in `frontend/` and it passes
- [ ] No debug `console.log` added to committed code
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation if needed
